headline: Bitcoin Traders Respond Following Binance Security Breach
summary: Large bitcoin traders reacted to news of a security breach affecting cryptocurrency exchange Binance, monitoring trading activity in the aftermath of the incident.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Security incidents involving major trading platforms can threaten market liquidity and investor confidence across digital assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin trading flows and sentiment are directly influenced by operational and security events at major crypto exchanges.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
